baselineDisplay.title: A Noble Gangster
baselineDisplay.question: How did Hawkwood make money in times of peace?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 霍克伍德在和平时期是如何赚钱的？
baselineDisplay.text:
How did Hawkwood make money in times of peace?

Editorial note: This reading corrects dates and names in the textbook’s comparison of gangsters and mercenary soldiers; the recording retains the original wording. There was a time when the owners of shops and businesses in Chicago had to pay large sums of money to gangsters in return for “protection”.
If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
Obtaining 'protection money' is not a modern crime.
The textbook compares this practice with the conduct of the fourteenth-century English mercenary commander Sir John Hawkwood: people would rather pay large sums than have their life’s work destroyed.
Hawkwood came to Italy with a band of soldiers in the fourteenth century and later settled near Florence.
He became known in Italy as Giovanni Acuto, an Italianised form of his English name.
Whenever the Italian city-states were at war with each other, Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes who were willing to pay the high price he demanded.
The textbook describes him and his men threatening city-states and demanding money to leave them alone.
Hawkwood made large sums of money in this way.
Despite such conduct, the Florentine authorities honoured his military service.
When he died in 1394, the Florentines gave him a grand funeral. In 1436, Paolo Uccello painted the equestrian memorial in Florence’s cathedral; it was not painted at the time of the funeral.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
编者注：本文校正教材将黑帮与雇佣军作比较时涉及的年代和姓名；录音保留原文。曾经有一段时间，芝加哥的商店和企业老板不得不向黑帮支付巨额费用，以换取他们的“保护”。
如果钱没有及时支付，黑帮分子会迅速毁掉他的店铺，让他破产。
收取“保护费”这种行为其实并非现代才有的犯罪行为。
教材将这种行为与十四世纪英国雇佣军统帅约翰·霍克伍德的所作所为相比较：人们宁愿付出大笔钱财，也不愿毕生心血被毁。
霍克伍德在十四世纪带领一队士兵来到意大利，后来在佛罗伦萨附近定居。
他在意大利被称为乔瓦尼·阿库托，这是其英文姓名的意大利语形式。
每当意大利各城邦之间发生战争时，霍克伍德就会把他的士兵出租给那些愿意支付他所索高价的城邦君主。
教材描述他和手下威胁各城邦，索取钱财，以换取不再侵扰。
霍克伍德就是通过这种方式赚到了大量的钱。
尽管有这样的行为，佛罗伦萨当局仍表彰了他的军功。
1394年他去世时，佛罗伦萨人为他举行了隆重的葬礼。1436年，保罗·乌切洛在佛罗伦萨大教堂绘制了纪念他的骑马像；这幅画并非在葬礼当时绘制。

display.title: A Noble Gangster
display.question: How did Hawkwood make money in times of peace?
display.questionZh: 霍克伍德在和平时期是如何赚钱的？
display.text:
How did Hawkwood make money in times of peace?

There was a time when the owners of shops and businesses in Chicago had to pay large sums of money to gangsters in return for 'protection'.
If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
Obtaining 'protection money' is not a modern crime.
As long ago as the fourteenth century, an Englishman, Sir John Hawkwood, made the remarkable discovery that people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.
Six hundred years ago, Sir John Hawkwood arrived in Italy with a band of soldiers and settled near Florence.
He soon made a name for himself and came to be known to the Italians as Giovanni Acuto.
Whenever the Italian city-states were at war with each other, Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes who were willing to pay the high price he demanded.
In times of peace, when business was bad, Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state, and after burning down a few farms, would offer to go away if protection money was paid to them.
Hawkwood made large sums of money in this way.
In spite of this, the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero.
When he died at the age of eighty, the Florentines gave him a state funeral and had a picture painted which was dedicated to the memory of 'the most valiant soldier and most notable leader, Signor Giovanni Haukodue'.

display.bodyTextZh:
曾经有一段时间，芝加哥的商店和企业的老板们不得不向黑帮支付巨额费用，以换取他们的“保护”。
如果钱没有及时支付，黑帮分子会迅速毁掉他的店铺，让他破产。
收取“保护费”这种行为其实并非现代才有的犯罪行为。
早在十四世纪，一位名叫约翰·霍克伍德（Sir John Hawkwood）的英国人就发现了一个惊人的事实：人们宁愿花大钱，也不愿自己的毕生心血被强盗毁掉。
六百年前，约翰·霍克伍德带着一队士兵来到意大利，并在佛罗伦萨附近安顿下来。
他很快就声名鹊起，在意大利人中被称为乔瓦尼·阿库托（Giovanni Acuto）。
每当意大利各城邦之间发生战争时，霍克伍德就会把他的士兵雇佣给那些愿意出高价的王子们。
在和平时期，当没生意可做时，霍克伍德和他的手下就会开进某个城邦，烧毁几个农场，然后提出只要付给他们保护费，他们就会离开。
霍克伍德就是通过这种方式赚到了大量的钱。
尽管如此，意大利人仍将他视为一位英雄。
他八十岁去世时，佛罗伦萨人为他举行了国葬，还请人画了一幅像，以纪念'最勇敢的战士和最杰出的领袖，乔瓦尼·阿库托先生'。
